model_annotations.Bulgarian: This chart is a multi-level (sunburst) pie chart that categorizes character types into a hierarchical structure. The innermost ring is divided into three main categories: "Virtual Characters," shown in blue and occupying the largest portion (approximately 60–65% of the inner circle); "Custom Characters," shown in pink and representing roughly 15–20%; and "Real Characters," shown in green and accounting for approximately 15–20%. The outer ring further subdivides these main categories into more specific types. Under Virtual Characters, the outer ring includes "Comic Characters" (the largest outer slice, in light blue), "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters," all rendered in varying shades of light blue and arranged roughly in descending order of size moving clockwise. Under Custom Characters, there is a single light pink slice labeled "Custom Characters" (matching its parent). Under Real Characters, the outer ring is subdivided into several smaller slices in light green, labeled "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers," each appearing as relatively thin segments. The chart does not include a separate legend, but all slices are directly labeled with text placed either inside or adjacent to each segment. No percentage values are explicitly displayed. The slices are not exploded or offset, and the hierarchical nesting visually conveys the parent-child relationships between the inner and outer categories.
